This engagement takes place after the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] entered service with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. In addition, the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] occurs at the end of ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''. Organa's capture takes place on 35:3:3 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system, placing it at the beginning of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to [[Template:YearMathGRS|the following explanation]]. Missions of ''Empire at War'' after the X-wing's introduction therefore take place between 1 BBY and 0 BBY but 1 BBY is more likely.
